source: Math grade 3, chapter 2, lesson «معرفی عدد هزار» (book pp. 28–30). Card MATH-06 (source docx v1 + detailed card): quest «انبار روستا باید موجودی بزرگی را ثبت کند»; grouping + stacking with crate snap, «۱۰ بستهٔ صدتایی → یک مجموعهٔ هزارتایی»; wrong answer = an incomplete group is made and highlighted; misconception MATH_THOUSAND_AS_COUNT_NOT_GROUP (1000 only as ‘a big number’; v1: compares numbers by written length); H1 «چند صدتایی داری؟», H2 highlight the hundred crates, H3 10 groups turn into one big crate; animations block_stack, crate_close, group_merge; analytics unit_grouped, hundred_group_created, thousand_group_created, grouping_error, solved. Textbook p.28: cookie → packet (10) → box (100) → carton (1000); ‘10 packs of 100 make 1000’; p.29 pattern ۱۰۰، ۲۰۰ … ۱۰۰۰; p.30: ten hundred-flats make 1000, 1000 has four digits. Strategy «الگوسازی» (p.26) on the encounter.

phases.objective_fa: جعبهٔ صدتایی را با ده‌تایی‌ها پر کن و طناب را بکش.
حالا جعبهٔ بزرگ را با صدتایی‌ها پر کن و طناب را بکش.

hints.animation: LUMI circles over the container and the tally board; the crates inside pulse one by one (card H1: «چند صدتایی داری؟»)

the crates of the right unit glow on the rack; every empty slot shows a dashed outline with its tally number (۷۰۰، ۸۰۰ … ۱۰۰۰) — the counting pattern (card H2: highlight the hundred crates; strategy «الگوسازی» p.26). Label phase: the tally cells light one by one ۱۰۰ … ۱۰۰۰

ghost crates slide into the empty slots one by one while the tally counts on, then the ghost lid closes and the group merges into one big crate (card H3: 10 groups turn into one big crate). Label phase: a ghost ۱۰۰۰ plate appears on the crate

stages.source_note: card: the child builds the groups herself — ten tens close into one hundred-crate (textbook p.28 packet → box), then ten hundred-crates (the one she just made + nine from the rack) close into the thousand-crate (box → carton). Loose blocks / ten-crates on the rack are the wrong-size distractors (card misconception: counting objects, not groups). Finale: the ۱۰۰۰ plate appears with «ده تا صدتایی، یک هزارتایی».

phases.objective_fa: جعبهٔ بزرگ نیمه‌پر است؛ کاملش کن و طناب را بکش.

stages.source_note: card practice: the thousand-crate already holds some hundreds (textbook p.28: «اگر علی ۹ سکهٔ ۱۰۰ ریالی بدهد چند تای دیگر…») — the child fills only the missing ones; the rack has one hundred too many (a drop into the full crate is refused, not an error). Then the label: ۱۰۰ names the crate by one of its groups (MATH_THOUSAND_AS_COUNT_NOT_GROUP), ۱۰۰۰۰ is ‘just a big number’ (card v2: MATH_THOUSAND_JUST_BIG_NUMBER; v1: longer number = bigger).

misconceptions.description: Counts ten objects, not ten groups: puts a ten-crate (or a loose block) where a hundred-crate (a ten-crate) belongs, as if any ten things make the next unit (card MATH-06).
Labels the full thousand-crate ۱۰۰ — names the crate by one of its groups instead of ten groups of a hundred (card MATH-06).
Picks the longest / biggest-looking number (۱۰۰۰۰) for the thousand-crate: 1000 only as ‘a big number’, compared by written length (card v1 + v2).

procedure_errors.note: card wrong answer: pulling the rope with fewer than ten groups — the lid bounces back up and the empty slots are highlighted. Counts as a wrong attempt for hints; not a misconception.

design_mitigations.note: all crates of one unit share one sprite and one size, and every crate shows its value on its brass plate (engine-written ۱۰ / ۱۰۰ / ۱۰۰۰), so the child never has to guess a unit from colour; the relative sizes stay true (a ten-crate is one tenth of a hundred-crate's width) so size supports — never replaces — the count.

mastery.note: card: L1 sees the thousand built, L2 builds it with H1/H2, L3 fills and labels a thousand-crate alone (concrete model + numeral). L4/L5 need the transfer in another context (market inventory / coins, later quest, plan 06 §9).
